sources_considered.why: Primary report of a substantial deployment predating the post; retained as context because the reported measurement is from February.

evidence_items.locator: Second performance bullet following the opening paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: This is material evidence against a blanket assertion that generative AI could perform no substantial business automation. It is a company estimate for one workflow before the target period, not proof of broad economic automation or OpenAI's survival economics.

The original evaluation documents serious limitations in general computer-task automation before the post. A benchmark failure pattern cannot establish inability across all commercially useful workflows or the capabilities specifically needed for survival.

unresolved_gaps: The cited measurements precede July and are context, not matched-period outcome evidence.
No representative evidence establishes the breadth and economics of July 2024 workflow automation.
The capability threshold necessary for OpenAI's survival is not independently established.
A single deployment and a general computer-use benchmark cannot settle the combined proposition.
